title: The Eve of the Twin Confrontation
next_chapter_hook: Chen Tianming placed the treasure radiating cold light into Chen Ji's palm, his remnant soul already beginning to dissipate: "This item is called 'Counter-Fate Talisman', it allows you to place a piece not belonging to the Heavenly Dao on fate's chessboard. Remember, only one chance."

text.content: The young girl's figure in the void, bearing an uncanny resemblance to Chen Ji in features, slowly dissipated, leaving only a wisp of warmth circling in the secret chamber. Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, the candles flickering around him, casting his pale face in uncertain light. On the first page of the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul was watching him, eyes filled with indescribably complex emotions. "She is Chen Nian." Mo Xiansheng's voice was hoarse, "Your sister, whom you have searched through all seven scrolls for." Chen Ji said nothing, only slowly placing his hand on the Tianji Record's cover, fingertips trembling slightly—the only overflow of emotion this废物 physique could not suppress.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" The door to the secret chamber was forcefully pushed open. Su Qingyao, her azure robes stained with night dew and hair slightly disheveled, rushed before Chen Ji: "Do you know how long you were unconscious? Three whole hours! The light from the Tianji Record alarmed the entire Tianqing Sect!" Her tone was urgent and angry, yet her hand gently pressed against Chen Ji's pulse gate, her fingertips warm and faintly trembling, revealing genuine worry: "If Elder Ling Yuan hadn't personally sealed the news, the three major sects would have come bearing down on us by now."

text.content: Chen Ji felt that familiar touch on his pulse gate, the corners of his lips lifting slightly into a smile so faint it was barely visible. This girl, clearly worried sick, yet never minces her words. He gently drew back his hand and stood up, the gray robes of a Servant Disciple appearing especially shabby in the candlelight, but within those calm eyes like ancient wells, stars were quietly revolving. "Gather everyone." His voice wasn't loud, yet carried undeniable resolve: "Tonight, I wish to see Ling Yuan, Han Lie, and... everyone you can find."

dialogue.content: "No need to gather them." From the depths of the secret chamber, an aged yet authoritative voice rang out. Ling Yuan's figure slowly emerged from the shadows, like a sculpture stepping out from the depths of history. His aura was profound as an abyss; even with deliberate restraint, a Generation Master's pressure made the air congeal. His gaze toward Chen Ji was complex and hard to discern—，既有长辈的审视，又有某种隐晦的忌惮，"I have already summoned Han Lie from Xuanwu Sect as well. Chen Ji, what exactly did you see in the Tianji Record?"

"Hmph!" A domineering aura crushed in from outside the door. Han Lie strode into the secret chamber, the Xuanwu Sect's unique black iron battle armor reflecting cold light under the candles. Upon seeing Ling Yuan, a flash of anger crossed his brow, but he snorted coldly and actually took the initiative to restrain his aura: "Old man, today I give Chen Ji face and won't argue with you." His gaze fell on Chen Ji, the fighting intent burning in those tiger eyes rarely diminished: "Chen Ji, you said you have something to announce—speak."

text.content: The atmosphere in the secret chamber suddenly grew heavy. Chen Ji scanned his surroundings—Ling Yuan, Han Lie, Su Qingyao, Ye Qing who had arrived upon hearing the news, and even Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul floating half-transparent from the Tianji Record. These people, some had been his enemies, some elders who had secretly guarded him, others allies who had fought shoulder to shoulder; tonight, they would all hear the decision he was about to make. He spoke slowly, his voice terrifyingly calm: "Tomorrow, I will go to the crossroads of fate for the final confrontation with my destined twin."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's face turned deathly pale. She stepped forward abruptly, hands tightly gripping Chen Ji's sleeves, her voice trembling: "You said final confrontation? What does that mean? Every use of the Tianji Record consumes Heavenly Fate Value, and yours is nearly depleted—are you going to—" She didn't finish, but everyone understood her implication. Han Lie's tiger eyes bulged, fury blazing: "Chen Ji! You dare!" Ling Yuan said nothing, only a flicker of indecipherable light passing through those deep eyes.

choice.prompt: Amid the crowd's shock, Chen Ji needed to make a decision—how to inform everyone of his plan.

choices.description: Completely disclose the full truth of the Tianji Record, possible sacrifices, and Chen Nian's existence to everyone, letting them make their own choices.
choices.visible_cost: Losing information advantage, may trigger panic
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may have ulterior motives

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly laying bare the truth of the Tianji Record: "Each completion of the Tianji Record strengthens fate's lethal backlash. I foresaw my own death, but I also saw the method to break the局." He paused, voice low: "My sister Chen Nian is the true key to this chess game."

dialogue.content: "Bullshit!" Han Lie slammed the table, his domineering aura nearly overturning the secret chamber: "What do you mean foresee your own death? I won't allow it! Chen Ji, listen to me—tomorrow I'll accompany you. Anyone who dares touch a single hair on you, I'll make them bleed five steps!" His eyes were actually slightly red, yet his voice grew more resolute: "废物? You think I lost to you multiple times for no reason? Because you're worth my everything!"

choices.text: Only reveal the plan, conceal the worst outcome
choices.description: Tell everyone there is a method to break the局, but omit the fact that he may not survive, bearing fate's weight alone.
choices.visible_cost: If he fails, no one will know the truth
choices.visible_reward: Protecting everyone from doing foolish things at the final moment
choices.risk_hint: May be seen through by Su Qingyao

text.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly, that smile appearing especially gentle in the candlelight: "Everyone, rest assured. Since I dare go, I naturally have confidence in escaping unharmed. The Tianji Record has already shown me a bright path." As he spoke, his gaze casually swept over Su Qingyao: "However, before that, I need each of you to prepare your own contingency plans."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao said nothing, only quietly watching Chen Ji, those clear cold eyes like containing an invisible blade. She stepped forward slowly, suddenly raising her hand, fingertip touching Chen Ji's heart: "You're lying to me again." A bitter smile curved her lips: "Chen Ji, do you think after knowing you this long, I can't tell? Every time you say 'rest assured,' that's precisely when you're most worried."

choices.text: Let everyone decide together how to respond
choices.description: Not unilaterally announcing the decision, but letting everyone jointly discuss strategies to break the局, harnessing collective wisdom.
choices.visible_reward: Making everyone a part of the chess game

text.content: "I won't make the decision." Chen Ji shook his head, slowly sitting down amid the crowd's astonishment: "This chess game shouldn't be played by me alone. Everyone, each of you is an indispensable piece on the board." He spread open his palm, the Tianji Record's light flowing within: "Now, tell me your thoughts."

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan remained silent for a long while before finally sighing deeply. An unusually rare gentleness appeared on that aged face: "Chen Ji, you are more of a leader than your father." He spoke slowly: "Back then, Chen Tianming saw me as a threat and passed the legacy to you... I harbored resentment, but tonight, I finally understand why he made that choice."

text.content: Just then, the air in the secret chamber suddenly froze. A brilliant Spiritual Light tore through the void, as if something was forcing its way through the cracks of fate. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—that was a scene never appearing in Tianji Record's prophecies. As the light faded, a figure slowly condensed. The moment Chen Ji saw that face, his entire body went rigid. It was a face bearing five-tenths resemblance to his own, yet more aged, with time-carved lines at the corners of the eyes. Only those eyes were identical to Chen Ji's.

dialogue.content: "Father?!" Chen Ji's voice lost its composure for the first time. Chen Tianming—that Chen Family ancestor who was said to have perished long ago in legend, now stood before him, aura ethereal as if he might dissipate at any moment. Chen Tianming looked at his son's shocked face and smiled faintly: "What, not used to seeing the dead?" His voice was gentle yet carried a hint of apology: "Feigning my death was my choice. The time left for you was too short; I had to let you grow in an environment without protection."

"Do you know why I feigned my death back then?" Chen Tianming walked slowly toward Chen Ji, each step stirring faint light: "Because the Tianji Record chose you, and I... was an obstacle placed by fate." His gaze was profound, as if seeing through the river of time: "If I had been alive then, fate's gaze would have focused on me. You would never have escaped the observation of the Heavenly Eye. After I feigned my death, your废物 reputation became the best protection."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a suffocating silence. All these years, he thought he was an abandoned piece, thought his father had long perished, never knowing this was all a meticulously designed chess game. His fists slowly clenched, nails piercing his palms, yet the pain couldn't conceal the emotions churning in his heart. "So..." He spoke with difficulty, voice hoarse: "You've been watching all along?" Chen Tianming nodded,心疼 flashing in his eyes: "Watching you grow step by step to today. I am very proud, my son."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's eyes were already moist. She had never seen Chen Ji so vulnerable. She wanted to step forward and comfort him, yet found her feet also frozen in place by this sudden truth. Ling Yuan, Han Lie, Ye Qing—everyone fell silent at this moment. Chen Tianming's remnant soul was already becoming transparent, clearly unable to hold on much longer. He looked at Chen Ji, determination in his gaze: "Ji'er, my time is running out. For tomorrow's battle, I leave you one final thing."

choice.prompt: Chen Tianming is about to hand over his final legacy. Chen Ji needs to make a choice.

choices.description: Unconditionally trust Chen Tianming's arrangement, taking the legacy that may be the final hope.
choices.visible_reward: Receiving Chen Tianming's complete inheritance and blessing

dialogue.content: Chen Tianming nodded in satisfaction, taking a talisman radiating cold light from the void: "This item is called 'Counter-Fate Talisman', crafted from my entire life's effort. It allows you to place a piece not belonging to the Heavenly Dao on fate's chessboard." He placed the talisman into Chen Ji's palm, his remnant soul body beginning to dissipate rapidly: "Remember, only one chance. Tomorrow... my son, go rewrite fate."

choices.description: Before accepting the legacy, inquire about the complete truth regarding Chen Nian, the complete Tianji Record, and fate's lethal backlash.
choices.visible_cost: May not have time to hear everything
choices.visible_reward: Gaining key information to increase victory odds for tomorrow's battle
choices.risk_hint: Chen Tianming may dissipate at any moment

dialogue.content: "Wait!" Chen Ji suddenly grabbed Chen Tianming's dissipating wrist, voice urgent: "Where is Chen Nian? What exactly is the price for completing the Tianji Record? The lethal backlash of fate—" Chen Tianming's form grew increasingly faint, yet an eased smile appeared: "Your sister is in the deepest part of the Holy Sect. She is the Heavenly Fate Lock-Key, the key to breaking fate. As for the price..." His voice grew more distant: "You already have the answer, my son..."

choices.text: Beg his father to stay a moment longer
choices.description: Regardless of everything, hoping his father can stay a while longer, even if just ordinary家常话.
choices.visible_reward: Making up for years of regret, gaining inner peace

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's voice suddenly choked: "Father... stay a while longer." His eyes reddened, voice trembling unsteadily: "Even just one sentence... even just tell me, how have you been all these years..." Chen Tianming's remnant soul paused. Those eyes, identical to his son's, flashed with profound emotion. He sighed gently, reaching out to stroke Chen Ji's head: "Silly child... all these years, I have been by your side. Never left."

text.content: Chen Tianming's remnant soul finally dissipated completely, turning into scattered starlight drifting toward the heavens. The final wisp of light landed on the Counter-Fate Talisman in Chen Ji's palm, stirring a warm ripple. The secret chamber fell into long silence, only the candles crackling. Ling Yuan slowly rose, walking to Chen Ji, and for the first time, saluted as an equal: "Chen Ji, I owe your father an explanation. From today onward, everyone in Tianqing Sect is at your disposal." Han Lie snorted coldly, yet also rose to his feet: "Although I don't like your sickly appearance, tomorrow—I'll accompany you on this trip!"

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao finally stepped forward, disregarding everyone's gazes, and tightly grasped Chen Ji's hand. Her palm was slightly cool, yet conveyed silent resolve: "I don't know what you're going to do tomorrow, and I don't know how much you've hidden from us." Her voice was soft, yet every word was clear: "But I know one thing—you are not alone." She raised her head, those clear cold eyes blazing with unprecedented fervor: "Chen Ji, let me share your fate."

text.content: The night wind blew into the secret chamber, candles flickering. Chen Ji held Su Qingyao's hand, feeling that palm's warmth. He looked around—Ling Yuan, Han Lie, Ye Qing, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul. Whether for what reasons, at this moment, all stood on his side. He tucked the Counter-Fate Talisman in his chest. That talisman's cold light seemed to remind him: fate has already set the chessboard, and he, with a single piece's strength, would pry open the entire heavens. Night如墨, tomorrow's dawn will终究 come.
